text:
ConocoPhillips jumped 3.4% today to $134.19, driven by a sharp spike in oil prices tied to geopolitical tension. Iran escalated tanker attacks in the Middle East, and the Trump administration responded with new sanctions on Iranian "shadow fleet" vessels and talk of potential military operations — raising the risk of supply disruptions. Global oil prices surged to $125.44 a barrel, while U.S. crude hit $96.24, both moving higher on these headlines. For an oil major like ConocoPhillips, higher crude prices directly boost the value of reserves and near-term profits.

This move is part of a broader four-day rally; the stock has risen nearly 4% since October 1st as geopolitical risk has mounted and energy markets have tightened. The tension also comes amid domestic fuel-price concerns that have put energy policy in the political spotlight ahead of midterm elections, adding another layer of uncertainty to oil markets.
